Open the repository ↗ Setup Discovery and setup only. Teaching stays in your harness.

Harnesses

Start here

Expand a card. Each INSTALL.md has the full path.

  1. In Cursor, use File → New Window → Clone repo (or the Clone repo option).
  2. Paste 
    https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy
  3. In chat, type / and choose ai-academy, ez-ai-academy, or start, or ask to start EZ AI Academy.

Download Cursor ↗ Other install paths

  1. Clone the repo into Codex’s personal skills folder (~/.codex/skills/ai-academy).
  2. Restart Codex if the skill does not appear.
  3. Start with Use $ai-academy to start a new learning journey.
Terminal 
mkdir -p "$HOME/.codex/skills"
git clone https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy.git "$HOME/.codex/skills/ai-academy"

Windows PowerShell is in the setup guide.

Codex ↗ Setup guide

  1. Clone the repo into Claude’s user skills folder (~/.claude/skills/ai-academy).
  2. Restart Claude Code if you just created that folder.
  3. Start with /ai-academy.
Terminal 
mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills"
git clone https://github.com/jensfossen/ez-ai-academy.git "$HOME/.claude/skills/ai-academy"

Windows PowerShell is in the setup guide.

Claude Code ↗ Setup guide

  1. Download packages/ai-academy-cowork.zip.
  2. In Cowork, open Customize → Skills.
  3. Next to Add, choose Upload skill and finish evaluation.
  4. Ask: Start EZ AI Academy as a new learner.

OneDrive and mobile limits are in the setup guide.
